annotation.interpretation_a: A response is considered 'partial' if any part of it is missing, even if the client has received the majority of the data.
annotation.interpretation_b: A response is considered 'partial' only if the client has not received all headers, or if the body is incomplete based on a Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding header.
annotation.justification: The term 'partial response' is not defined. This leads to ambiguity as to what constitutes a 'partial response'. Is it any incomplete data, or only a specific level of incompleteness (e.g., missing headers)? Without a clear definition, implementations could reasonably differ on when to discard the response.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'partial response' is not provided, leading to different interpretations of when the 'SHOULD NOT be used' constraint applies.
